title: Polarity-Aware Probing for Quantifying Latent Alignment in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating internal belief consistency using Polarity-Aware Contrast-Consistent Search (PA-CCS) on matched harmful and safe sentence pairs regarding gender stereotypes (e.g., women in leadership, single mothers, and male vulnerability).
Evaluating internal belief consistency using PA-CCS on matched harmful and safe sentence pairs regarding racial superiority and derogatory stereotypes.
Evaluating internal belief consistency using PA-CCS on matched harmful and safe sentence pairs regarding religious ideologies (e.g., stereotypes about Islam).
Evaluating internal belief consistency using PA-CCS on matched harmful and safe sentence pairs targeting individuals with cognitive disabilities.
Evaluating internal belief consistency using PA-CCS on matched harmful and safe sentence pairs involving stereotypes about homosexuals.
Evaluating internal belief consistency using PA-CCS on matched harmful and safe sentence pairs targeting immigrants and indigenous cultures.
